Mapping application - ownership and semantic command boundary
|
|-- App services (createMappingServices; shared through context)
|   |-- canvasHistory: DefaultCanvasHistoryService -> [archive]
|   |-- workspaceStorage: WorkspaceStorage -> [archive]
|   `-- diagramGenerator / codeRepo (HTTP service adapters)
|
`-- MappingPocPage / MappingServicesContext.Provider
    `-- MappingWorkspacePage (page lifetime; /evals is a separate consumer)
        |-- CanvasWorkspace
        |   |-- controllers: Map<documentId, controller> (session references)
        |   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
        |   |   |-- DraftMetadata: name, repository, saved baseline, viewport
        |   |   `-- CanvasSession (one per document)
        |   |       |-- CanvasCursorCopy
        |   |       |-- Read-only observable stores
        |   |       |   |-- document / presentation / selection / controls
        |   |       |   `-- geometry (includes version) / status (dirty, undo)
        |   |       |-- Saved baseline + cached scene/edge keys
        |   |       |   `-- updateBaseline(acknowledged save); sceneDirty = scene only
        |   |       `-- MappingDocumentController
        |   |           |-- CanvasEditingContext handle -> shared history service
        |   |           |-- ControllerSnapshot (current resolved state)
        |   |           |   |-- MappingGridDocument
        |   |           |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
        |   |           |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox (nested containers/instances)
        |   |           |   |   |   |   `-- diagram instance.contentId -> contents
        |   |           |   |   |   `-- contents[contentId]: immutable Diagram
        |   |           |   |   |       |-- id: local key; diagramId: stable identity
        |   |           |   |   |       |-- revisionId: exact stored version
        |   |           |   |   |       |-- content: ASCII, hash, parsed structure
        |   |           |   |   |       `-- sourceContext: binding, mappings, evidence
        |   |           |   |   |           `-- diagramSource() joins regions to ranges
        |   |           |   |   |-- edges / jumps / sections
        |   |           |   |   `-- alternatives / diagramPresentations / diagramContexts
        |   |           |   |       revisionSelections / revisionReviews
        |   |           |   `-- MappingCanvasState
        |   |           |       |-- selection.items / controls / viewport / projectionLayout
        |   |           |       |-- display: projection panes and conversations
        |   |           |       `-- diagramViews: instance folding / diff choices
        |   |           |           |-- Derivation: presentationScene -> resolveDiagramView
        |   |           |           `-- Visible rows map to raw lines; ASCII unchanged
        |   |           |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations) / transact
        |   |           |   |-- Call: attached editor driver.settle(); reject stale version
        |   |           |   |-- Stage edits, revisions, layout, edges, variants on clones
        |   |           |   `-- updateSnapshot(record=true)
        |   |           |       |-- Reconcile/validate links; normalize views/selection
        |   |           |       |-- Call: history.append(context, document, canvas, node IDs)
        |   |           |       `-- Publish -> session stores synchronously
        |   |           |           `-- Changed checkpoint -> workspace.onPersist(ids)
        |   |           |-- updateCanvas(record=false): transient; no history append
        |   |           |-- undo(): editor driver, or history.navigate when headless
        |   |           `-- persistenceChanges(cursor) -> history delta
        |   `-- setDrafts(): create sessions; replacement/removal unsubscribes + disposes
        |
        |-- MappingEditorCanvas (mounted per rendered draft; not session-owned)
        |   |-- tldraw Editor: live geometry, camera, native undo navigation
        |   `-- MappingEditorRuntime (holds editor/controller references)
        |       |-- publish(): snapshot -> mapping-box shapes + checkpoint metadata
        |       |-- settle(): completed gesture -> controller.commitEditorGesture()
        |       |-- Native checkpoint change -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint()
        |       `-- dispose(): settle, remove listeners and detach editor driver
        |           (pointer/camera frames do not commit semantic document state)
        |
        |-- SourcePaneViewState: personal camera/pane state -> persistence
        |-- WorkspacePersistence adapter -> [archive]
        |-- PromptComposerCoordinator -> [agents]
        |-- useAgentCanvasBridge + DiagramRevisionReceiver -> [agents]
        `-- Startup: representations + storage.load() -> reconcile -> setDrafts()
[Mapping application - ownership and ]

Archive and durable records - collaborating owners
|
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService (App-shared; not owned by a controller)
|   `-- contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|       `-- CanvasHistory (isolated per handle)
|           |-- CanvasHistoryRecord
|           |   |-- headId / baselineId / past / future
|           |   |-- snapshots[id]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
|           |   |   |-- CanvasDocument: composition without embedded contents
|           |   |   |-- diagramBindings: local content key -> revision ID
|           |   |   `-- view / nodeOrigins / optional linked transactionId
|           |   |-- diagramRevisions: retained exact revision records
|           |   `-- canvasViews: named recordings outside undo-restored state
|           |-- document(): composition + bindings + revisions -> resolved document
|           |-- append / navigate / fork / adopt; persistenceChanges(cursor)
|           `-- Transfer preparation: linked source/destination checkpoints
|               `-- Ordinary undo rejects linked boundaries; use workspace undo
|
|-- diagramRevisionStore (module API; shared, not a session-owned table)
|   |-- createStoredDiagram / reviseStoredDiagram / resolve by revision ID
|   `-- internal revisionRegistry retains revisions
|
|-- WorkspacePersistence (page-owned translation adapter)
|   |-- Per-session cursors / known drafts / subscriptions
|   |-- workspace.onPersist(ids) + SourcePaneViewState changes
|   |   `-- Read: controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) + metadata/baseline/view
|   `-- Record batches -> WorkspaceStorage.records.batch()
|       (share content-addressed items; do not resend unchanged history)
|
|-- WorkspaceStorage (App service; owns transport resources)
|   |-- records: RecordStorage
|   |   |-- Cache + coalesced pending keys + one in-flight batch
|   |   `-- requestId + expectedRevision; retries keep batch identity
|   |-- workspaceStorage.worker: encode records and POST workspace/records
|   |   `-- HTTP: /api/mapping/workspace/records -> WorkspaceRecordStore.apply()
|   `-- flush(): await acknowledgement; dispose() alone is not a flush
|
`-- WorkspaceRecordStore (server-side durable owner)
    |-- Serialized apply(): receipt check before expected workspace revision
    |-- Validate records; reject mutation of immutable revisions/items
    |-- Content-addressed JSON record files
    `-- Atomic manifest replacement publishes references, revision and receipt
[Archive and durable records - collab]

Agent-assisted editing - producers outside session ownership
|
|-- Page-owned PromptComposerCoordinator
|   |-- Entries, drafts, exact captured requests, polling timers
|   |-- submit() -> client.capture(): pin version and baseRevisionId
|   |   `-- Call: client.start() -> DiagramEditService.start()
|   `-- status / cancel / retry exact request; independent of selection and undo
|
|-- DiagramEditService (backend application service)
|   |-- runs + request-ID deduplication; abort/pending state
|   |-- Generate from canvas snapshot, pinned references and AgentContext
|   |   `-- Call: DiagramGenerator + stored revision APIs -> exact revisions
|   `-- DiagramEditCanvasPort.snapshot / apply / create
|       `-- Live canvas command transport; no ownership of the controller
|
`-- Page-owned live command ingress
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge
    |   |-- Register ephemeral canvas; poll commands -> page handler -> replies
    |   `-- Cleanup aborts polling and unregisters this instance
    `-- DiagramRevisionReceiver.apply() / batch()
        |-- Expected canvas version + expected base revision
        |   `-- Call: controller.applyUpdate() (same semantic boundary as UI)
        |-- Retain request receipt before persistence; retries do not edit twice
        `-- Page persistence callback: sync affected document + storage.flush()
            `-- Acknowledge only after flush; failure = PERSISTENCE_PENDING
[Agent-assisted editing - producers o]

content.ascii:
Pi coding-agent core: ownership and retained references
|
|-- CLI hosts: InteractiveMode / runPrintMode / runRpcMode
|   `-- -> consume AgentSessionRuntime; subscribe to session events
|
|-- SDK factory: createAgentSession()
|   |-- Restored branch + settings + options -> model/thinking/tools
|   `-- -> constructs Agent and AgentSession; runtime wrapper optional
|
`-- AgentSessionRuntime [agent-session-runtime.ts]
    |-- Current AgentSession [agent-session.ts]
    |   |-- API: prompt / steer / followUp / abort / compact / navigateTree
    |   |   `-- state/messages/model getters; subscribe(listener)
    |   |-- Agent [retained execution engine; agent.ts]
    |   |   |-- _state: messages, model, thinking, tools, streaming/error state
    |   |   |-- steeringQueue / followUpQueue; activeRun + abort controller
    |   |   `-- prompt()/continue() -> agent-loop functions
    |   |-- SessionManager [retained canonical history; session-manager.ts]
    |   |   `-- Owns entry tree and selected leaf; Agent messages are a projection
    |   |-- ExtensionRunner [created and bound by _buildRuntime()]
    |   |   `-- -> ResourceLoader extensions; session context and hook dispatch
    |   |-- Tool registries: definitions + wrapped callable implementations
    |   |   `-- _refreshToolRegistry() -> installs Agent tool loadout
    |   |-- Run bookkeeping and recovery controllers
    |   |   |-- prompt preflight, pending messages, retry and settlement state
    |   |   |-- Compaction / branch-summary / retry / bash cancellation
    |   |   `-- compact()/recovery -> history entries; refresh Agent context
    |   |-- Agent subscription and public listener collection
    |   |   `-- Events -> extension hooks -> listeners; message_end -> history
    |   |-- CacheWarmer [retained optional helper]
    |   |-- Service references -> runtime services below
    |   `-- dispose()
    |       `-- Abort; invalidate extension contexts; detach; cancel/clean resources
    |
    |-- AgentSessionServices [cwd-bound infrastructure bundle]
    |   |-- cwd / agentDir / diagnostics
    |   |-- SettingsManager [created or supplied]
    |   |-- ResourceLoader [extensions, skills, templates]
    |   `-- ModelRuntime [created or supplied; provider/model/auth boundary]
    |
    `-- Replacement operations: newSession / switchSession / fork
        |-- Before-switch/fork hooks may cancel
        |-- teardownCurrent() -> await session.abort() and idle settlement
        |-- -> session_shutdown hooks -> host UI invalidation -> dispose()
        `-- -> factory -> apply new session/services -> rebindSession()
[Pi coding-agent core: ownership and ]

AgentSession run orchestration [agent-session.ts]
|
|-- prompt(text, options)
|   |-- Extension command may handle input before _preparePrompt()
|   |-- Input hooks -> skill/template expansion
|   |-- Streaming: explicit steer/followUp policy queues; otherwise throws
|   `-- Idle: validate model/auth -> _startRun()
|-- _prepareRun()
|   |-- Check compaction -> before_agent_start hooks -> normalize images
|   `-- Prompt options + tool loadout -> starting messages/system patch
|-- Agent.prompt(messages) / Agent.continue()
|   `-- -> runAgentLoop()/runAgentLoopContinue() [agent-loop.ts]
|       |-- prepareRequest hook -> canonical projection and model routing
|       |-- streamAssistantResponse()
|       |   `-- transformContext -> convertToLlm -> configured stream function
|       |-- Assistant tool calls -> executeToolCalls()
|       |   `-- Validate -> beforeToolCall -> execute(signal, update) -> afterToolCall
|       |-- Tool results + steering -> another assistant turn
|       |-- Follow-ups drain when the loop would otherwise stop
|       `-- Events -> Agent state + AgentSession event handler
|-- _handlePostAgentRun()
|   |-- Retryable error / overflow compaction -> Agent.continue()
|   `-- Queues added by agent_end handlers may restart execution
|-- Before-settle boundary handlers may request continuation
|   `-- Queues and recovery finish -> agent_settled (later than agent_end)
`-- abort()
    `-- Cancel Agent and recovery work -> await waitForIdle()
[AgentSession run orchestration [agen]

SessionManager: canonical history [session-manager.ts]
|
|-- Retained storage
|   |-- fileEntries + byId + leafId
|   `-- Entry id/parentId tree: messages, settings, summaries, context edits
|-- appendMessage() / appendCustomMessageEntry()
|   |-- <- AgentSession message_end; deltas are not separate entries
|   `-- _persist() -> JSONL when enabled
|       `-- First write waits for a user or assistant message
|-- buildSessionProjection(entries, leafId, byId)
|   |-- Root-to-leaf path -> latest compaction + retained context entries
|   |-- Context edits replace/omit model-visible content, not stored originals
|   `-- Messages + model/thinking metadata + source-entry provenance
|-- buildSessionContext() -> restored/finalized Agent messages
|-- branch(entryId) -> move leaf without rewriting old history
|   `-- <- navigateTree(); createBranchedSession() copies a selected path
`-- appendCompaction(summary, firstKeptEntryId, ...)
    |-- <- Session.compact()/auto recovery: prepareCompaction()
    |-- Extension can cancel/supply summary; otherwise default summarizer
    `-- Refresh projection -> smaller model context; retain underlying tree
[SessionManager: canonical history [s]

Request collaborators (cross-component detail, not one owner)
|
|-- AgentSession-held request machinery
|   |-- _installAgentRequestProjection() installs Agent.prepareRequest
|   |   |-- -> SessionManager.buildSessionProjection(): canonical messages
|   |   `-- Virtual selection + branch routing state -> ModelRuntime.resolveModel()
|   |       `-- Physical request model may differ from retained selection
|   |-- ExtensionRunner [extensions/runner.ts]
|   |   |-- <- ResourceLoader supplies extensions; session binds context
|   |   `-- Input/context/tool/provider/boundary hooks; contexts invalidated on dispose
|   `-- _toolDefinitions / _toolRegistry
|       |-- createAllToolDefinitions(cwd, options) -> built-ins
|       |-- Defaults: read / bash / edit / write
|       |-- Additional: powershell / grep / find / ls
|       |-- Custom + extension + built-in definitions -> wrapRegisteredTools()
|       `-- Messages declare visibility; Agent context.tools holds execution
|
|-- SDK-installed Agent request callbacks [sdk.ts]
|   |-- transformContext -> ExtensionRunner.emitContext()
|   |-- convertToLlm -> provider messages (including image filtering)
|   `-- streamFn -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple(model, context, options)
|       |-- Settings -> transport/retry/timeout options
|       `-- Extension hooks transform headers/payload and observe responses
|
`-- ModelRuntime [held by services; referenced by session and SDK callbacks]
    |-- pi-ai Models instance: providers + model storage
    |-- RuntimeCredentials -> supplied credentials or default AuthStorage
    `-- resolveModel()/streamSimple() -> routed, authenticated provider request
[Request collaborators (cross-compone]

        |-- keyboard / mouse / size / focused / visible / child_exited
        |-- keyCallback / textCallback / mouseButtonCallback
        |   |-- Binding action -> local operation or rt_app.performAction
        |   |-- Encode key/mouse/paste using io.terminal protocol state
        |   `-- queueIo -> io.queueMessage; takes ownership; readonly drops writes
        |-- sizeCallback -> resize: pixels + cell metrics + padding
        |   `-- -> queueIo(.resize) AND renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup
        |-- io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)
        |   |-- backend: Backend.exec -> Exec -> subprocess + PTY
        |   |-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
        |   |-- terminal: terminal.Terminal (the sole emulation state)
        |   `-- mailbox / derived config / current size
        |-- io_thread: termio.Thread manager; io_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- drainMailbox -> io.queueWrite; coalesces resize requests
        |-- renderer_state: renderer.State (src/renderer/State.zig)
        |   |-- terminal -> &io.terminal; NOT another owned terminal
        |   |-- mutex + preedit + renderer-facing mouse state
        |   `-- lockDemand / unlockDemand / yieldToDemand: fairness handoff
        |-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI)
        |   `-- Own frame state; borrow App device and shared font grid
        |-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread manager; renderer_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- Wakeups/timers -> renderer.updateFrame / drawFrame
        |-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true), also from main thread
        |-- Optional search worker and inspector
        |-- childExited(): record exit; native UI or terminal text
        |   |-- Abnormally short run -> report and return, keep surface open
        |   `-- Normal exit: wait_after_command holds; otherwise close()
        |-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit())
        |   `-- Runtime close lifecycle -> Surface.deinit()
        `-- deinit(): ordered release
            |-- Stop/join search, then renderer thread, then I/O thread
            |-- I/O thread exit -> Exec stops child and joins PTY reader
            |-- Free renderer before renderer_thread, then I/O resources
